cost_definitions.model_forward_calls_inferred: INFERRED, not measured: serial HF structured_generate runs one initial model forward and one for each additional sampled output, hence sum raw generated_ids lengths across ALL calls. Native unavailable.
cost_definitions.prefill_calls_inferred: INFERRED, not measured: one initial HF prefill per positive-output generation call. Native unavailable.
cost_definitions.decode_calls_inferred: INFERRED, not measured: all raw generated tokens minus positive-output generation calls; no speculation in this backend. Native unavailable.
cost_definitions.F: Logical critical sequential sampled-token depth; native F=sampled length. Not measured GPU model-forward invocations.
cost_definitions.T_forced: Forced response tokens including think prefix/protocol bridges
cost_definitions.actual_generated_tokens: All generated token outputs across actual generation calls, including discarded outputs if any
cost_definitions.wall_seconds: Per-question generation elapsed, excludes engine startup; backend confounded
cost_definitions.backend_confound: Structured uses HF structured serial backend through vLLM worker RPC; native uses fast vLLM generation. Wall comparisons are descriptive and cannot establish parallel execution speedup.
